params.name: roadClass
params.description: Filters roads with specified class, allowed values are (Major, Secondary, Other and All), default is All

params.name: driveTime
params.description: Returns Intersection in specified drive time

params.name: driveTimeUnit
params.description: Drive time unit, allowed values are (hours, minutes, seconds and milliseconds), default is minutes

params.name: searchRadius
params.description: Search radius within which user wants to search, default is 50 miles

params.name: searchRadiusUnit
params.description: Search radius unit, allowed values are (feet, meter, kilometers and miles)

params.name: historicSpeed
params.description: Traffic flow in peak time, allowed values are (AMPEAK,PMPEAK,OFFPEAK,NIGHT)

params.name: maxCandidates
params.description: max candidates to be returned default is 1

items.docs: This service accepts latitude/longitude as input and returns the Nearest Intersection.
